extracted.intended_audience: prospective authors / writers seeking publication with Catapult (emerging and established literary writers)
extracted.subtask_short: submitting literary fiction and narrative nonfiction
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance describing the kinds of books Catapult publishes and the qualities they seek in literary fiction and artful narrative nonfiction submissions. Emphasizes thematic focus on the publisher's 'Perception Box' concept, craft, diversity, and work that challenges assumptions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Genre focus
rubrics_metrics.description: Catapult publishes literary fiction and artful narrative nonfiction.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Works should fit broadly within literary fiction or narrative nonfiction rather than commercial genre fiction; emphasis on artful, literary storytelling.

rubrics_metrics.name: Engages with the Perception Box
rubrics_metrics.description: Work should engage with our Perception Box, the powerful metaphor we use to define the structure and boundaries of how we see others in their full humanity, and invites new ways of seeing and being seen.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Manuscripts that interrogate, expand, or reframe how characters/subjects are perceived — inviting readers to see people differently — align with this editorial focus.

rubrics_metrics.name: Voice and vitality
rubrics_metrics.description: Our books are alive, insightful, illuminating, and surprising, written by vital voices—emerging and established—that honor the craft of writing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Editors seek lively, original voices that bring insight and surprise; both new and established authors are considered if the work demonstrates vitality and craft.

rubrics_metrics.name: Commitment to craft and editorial care
rubrics_metrics.description: We are committed to publishing with care, intention, and respect for our authors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Beyond initial selection, Catapult emphasizes careful editorial development and respectful author-publisher relationships; submissions should demonstrate attention to craft and readiness for collaborative editing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Challenge assumptions and biases
rubrics_metrics.description: We embrace writers and audiences who fearlessly shake up our assumptions and biases.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Preferred works interrogate received ideas and encourage readers to question assumptions — intellectually and morally challenging material is welcome.

rubrics_metrics.name: Explores ambiguity and nuance
rubrics_metrics.description: We celebrate stories that explore the space between the lines of our lives, that raise questions rather than give answers, and that rattle the walls of our Perception Box.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Narratives that foreground ambiguity, complexity, and open-ended inquiry (rather than tidy resolutions) fit the imprint's aesthetic.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reader-writer effort and depth
rubrics_metrics.description: We embrace writing that requires an effort on the part of both writer and reader to reach beyond our assumptions and biases to see the humanity, struggle, and truth in every human being.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submissions should offer depth and demand active engagement from readers; works that are richly wrought and reward close reading are valued.

rubrics_metrics.name: Diversity and representation
rubrics_metrics.description: We work with a diverse list of writers who have been historically underrepresented, broadening the literary landscape in the United States and beyond.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The imprint proactively seeks and values voices from underrepresented communities and perspectives as part of its editorial mission.
